test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

Can we make sure we have a lots of fun on the trip?
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the use of the phrase "**a lots of fun**".
 
• The correct phrase should be "**a lot of fun**".
 
• The term "**lot**" in this context does not take the plural form "**lots**" when preceded by "**a**".
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 4** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Can we make sure we have **a lot of fun** on the trip?"*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1) Can we make** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **2) on the trip?** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **3) sure we have** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **4) a lots of fun,** – This part of the sentence contains an error and needs to be corrected to "a lot of fun".
